g.title: One Tenant, every object it creates
g.text: One Tenant, every object it creates
What the glue does with a few lines of YAML for business unit retail-1042 · magenta = our code · white = upstream

g.title: cluster_legend_frame
g.text: The Tenant file is merged in the gitops repository; Argo CD applies it to the management cluster
The glue's XRD validates it: required fields, tenant ID format, at most 30 characters
The glue's Composition renders every object with a pipeline of Crossplane functions
Crossplane's providers create them: Kubernetes objects in the workload clusters, AWS resources
The glue's MLflow function grants the tenant's groups their experiments and models
The Tenant turns Ready when every object exists; Backstage shows it to the requester
Objects created by the providers; grey: created by Capsule; orange dots: workload identity
